preconditions.description: The number of members n is between 3 and 150,000.
The number of friendships m is between 0 and the minimum of n*(n-1)/2 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in friendships)
preconditions.description: Each friendship pair (ai, bi) consists of distinct members between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if all((x, z) in friendships for x, y, z in combinations(range(1, n+1), 3) if (x, y) in friendships and (y, z) in friendships) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The network is reasonable if for every three distinct members (X, Y, Z), if X-Y and Y-Z then also X-Z. Otherwise, it is not reasonable.
